summary: x87 rounding helper (__cdecl): loads the double argument a1 into ST7 and executes the frndint instruction, rounding it to an integer using the currently active FPU rounding mode. The rounded value is returned through the x87 register (ST7). No rounding mode is set or restored here; the ambient FPU control word governs the result.

operations.description: Load the double argument a1 into x87 register ST7.
Execute the x87 frndint instruction to round ST7 to an integer according to the current rounding mode.
Return the rounded double left in ST7 (x87 return convention); the decompiler's result is the ST7 copy.
Called by sub_5895A2 (0x005895A2) and DoubleIntegerAndDivisibilityClassification (0x0058DF5C) to round an FPU double to an integer under the active rounding mode.

clean_pseudocode: /* _ST7 = a1; then __asm frndint rounds ST7 to an integer
